SUPPORT

Mobile setup

Speech Recognition Cloud includes a mobile companion that turns your phone into a wireless microphone or voice-notes capture device for your Windows PC. The setup is the same on both platforms - choose your phone below to watch the right walkthrough video.

The mobile companion is available on the Professional and Medical plans.

Download the Mobile App guide (PDF)
iPhone Android

iPhone setup walkthrough

Android setup walkthrough

Quick reference

These steps are the same whether you are setting up iPhone or Android.

1

Install Speech Recognition Cloud on your Windows PC and sign in to your Professional or Medical account

2

In the SRC bar, click Settings (the cog in the top-left), then click Mobile (bottom-left), then enable Mobile Dictation

3

Pair your phone by scanning the QR code with your mobile camera, then Add to Home Screen when prompted

4

Start dictating. Use the phone as a wireless microphone for live dictation at your PC cursor, or switch the app into Voice Notes mode to send a complete document to the active SRC instance

Watch the video above for the full walkthrough including pairing and troubleshooting.

Having trouble?

Make sure your PC is signed in and Mobile Dictation is enabled in Settings before scanning the QR code. Both devices should be online during pairing.

Still stuck? Contact us and we will help you get it working.

Need Professional or Medical?

The mobile companion is included on Professional ($159/year) and Medical ($439/year) plans.
